title: Tobin Tax Policy, Housing Speculation, and Property Market Dynamics
authors: Sumit Agarwal; Kwong Wing Chau; Maggie Rong Hu; Wayne Xinwei Wan
eligible_reason: Single policy date: SSD = 1 if date >= Nov 20, 2010 for every transaction (Code/data_clean.do line 166; SSD2 for the Oct 27, 2012 amendment). Regressions are before/after (reghdfe log_hold_period_next c.SSD + property controls + p_rate), flipper x SSD interactions, probits, and monthly volume/volatility on SSD with the prime rate. No staggered binary treatment across units.
design_notes: Hong Kong residential transactions 1992-2017 (EPRC); Tobin-type Special Stamp Duty on resales within 24 months; tests flipper presence, holding periods, bunching after lock-in, prices, volume and volatility.
data_files_note: README: transaction data EPRC.dta (subscription, EPRC Limited) and the derived regression_sample.dta are not shipped; only public auxiliary files are included.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Territory-wide single-date tax; not staggered.
